domain_invariants.title: Stem Auditioning Temporal Invariant
domain_invariants.text: When switching audio channels or stems (dialogue, background, master mixdown) in BeforeAfterPlayer, the audioRef.current.currentTime MUST be preserved across switches, enabling seamless A/B comparison without resetting the playhead to 00:00.

domain_invariants.title: HTTP 206 Partial Content Media Bridge
domain_invariants.text: All video and audio playback must route through /api/v1/clips/preview-stream?path=... supporting HTTP 206 Partial Content byte ranges, avoiding memory exhaustion from full-file downloads and enabling native seeking on broadcast containers.

domain_invariants.title: GPU Accelerated Stages Invariant
domain_invariants.text: Pipeline stages transcription (Faster-Whisper), translation (Gemini/LLM), and tts (Kokoro-82M) are hardware-accelerated GPU/cloud stages. Extraction, denoise (zero-copy audio pass-through), duration_align, remix, and remux are CPU/FFmpeg stages.

domain_invariants.title: 4GB VRAM Hardware Limit
domain_invariants.text: ASR speech recognition is standardized on faster-whisper medium with int8 quantization to prevent CUDA OOM on GTX 1050 Ti (4GB VRAM) devices, with automatic fallback to CPU int8 upon missing CUDA libraries.

domain_invariants.title: Kokoro 24kHz PCM_16 Audio Stem Invariant
domain_invariants.text: All speech stems synthesized via KokoroTTSAdapter must be written using soundfile with subtype='PCM_16' at 24000 Hz, guaranteeing clean ingestion by Python standard library wave.open, check_audio_clipping, and FFmpeg amix.

domain_invariants.title: Singleton Thread-Safe Model Pipeline Cache
domain_invariants.text: Neural TTS pipelines (KPipeline) must be cached in a class-level singleton dictionary (_pipeline_cache) guarded by a threading.Lock, preventing duplicate VRAM allocations and OOM spikes on 4GB GPUs.

domain_invariants.title: Zero-Copy Denoise Pass-Through & Demucs Removal
domain_invariants.text: DenoiseStage performs direct zero-copy 16kHz audio routing for speech and background stems, completely removing Demucs neural stem separation overhead (~1.8GB VRAM savings) to eliminate OOM lock contention during concurrent transcription.

domain_invariants.title: Atomic ASR Transcription Checkpointing
domain_invariants.text: AudioChunker processes 30-second audio windows with persistent atomic transcription_checkpoint.json. Interrupted runs seamlessly resume from the last completed chunk without re-transcribing earlier audio.

domain_invariants.title: Downstream 24kHz Audio Seams & Defensive Duration Clamping
domain_invariants.text: All duration reconciliation (atempo time-stretching) and audio mastering (amix sidechain ducking & EBU R128 -24 LUFS normalization) must support 24,000 Hz 16-bit PCM WAV stems. All duration arithmetic must clamp input durations using max(0.1, duration) to prevent ZeroDivisionError.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: MultiAudioPlayer fell back to hardcoded sample clips (trial1 demo) on live run detail page.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: The tracks prop was omitted when invoking MultiAudioPlayer in frontend/app/runs/[id]/page.tsx, and deliverables were never fetched from the backend.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Added fetchDeliverables() calling GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/deliverables on initial mount and on WebSocket run_completed event. Extracted buildRunAudioTracks to synthesize original and localized streams with graceful fallback.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: BeforeAfterPlayer was an un-hydrated visual scaffold without audio playback or timestamp continuity.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: Component lacked an HTMLMediaElement audio engine, track switching event handlers, and active stream URL bindings.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Implemented HTML5 audio element with preload='metadata', switchTrackPreservingTimestamp, time scrubber, and decomposed into clean StemChannelCard sub-components.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: Vitest crashed when testing audio components with 'Not implemented: HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play'.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: JSDOM environment lacks native browser media decoding and playback engines.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Mocked window.HTMLMediaElement.prototype.play = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => Promise.resolve()) and pause = vi.fn() in test beforeEach hook.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: Multi-sentence dialogue monologues were truncated after the first sentence.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: Early return inside the generator loop for _, _, audio in generator: sf.write(...); return ... exited on chunk 1, discarding subsequent sentences.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Accumulate all chunks in a list comprehension and concatenate via np.concatenate before writing to disk.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: Dialogue lines containing only pauses or punctuation ('...') crashed with ValueError or produced missing WAV files.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: Phonemizer stripped non-lexical tokens, resulting in 0 chunks yielded by StyleTTS 2 generator.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Pre-check text with re.search(r'\w', text) and generate clean silent 16-bit PCM WAV matching target_duration_s using np.zeros.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: Targeted retries on Windows crashed with PermissionError: [WinError 32] when overwriting existing WAV stems.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: Windows OS file lock on active audio stream handles held by media player or browser bridge.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Write to sibling .tmp.wav and atomically replace via os.replace().

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: Dialogue segments with 0.0s or corrupt duration triggered ZeroDivisionError during atempo factor computation.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: Missing defensive clamp on raw_duration_s and target_duration_s before floating-point division.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Enforced raw_duration_s = max(0.1, float(raw_duration_s)) and target_duration_s = max(0.1, float(target_duration_s)) in duration_align.py and sync_engineer.py.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: 24kHz PCM_16 WAV dialogue stems were incorrectly flagged as clipped in QA analysis.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: check_audio_clipping assumed raw float32 normalized samples without proper 16-bit integer conversion scale [-32768, 32767].
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Standardized peak amplitude calculation in qa_agent.py, ensuring 0.79 <= peak <= 0.81 for valid audio and >= 0.999 for genuine clipping.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: CI test runners failed or timed out trying to connect to Hugging Face or initialize CUDA models.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: VoiceDirector tests previously executed unmocked pipeline initializations.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Created fast (<1.5s SLA), 100% offline unit test suite with mock KPipeline fixtures covering chunk aggregation, silence generation, Edge-TTS fallback, and exception resilience.

bug_resolution_traces.symptom: ollama serve fails with 'bind: Only one usage of each socket address (protocol/network address/port) is normally permitted'.
bug_resolution_traces.root_cause: Ollama is already running in the background as the Windows system tray application (ollama app.exe / ollama.exe), occupying port 11434 with default 127.0.0.1 binding.
bug_resolution_traces.resolution: Terminate background instances via Stop-Process -Name 'ollama', 'ollama app' -Force (or right-click Tray Icon -> Quit Ollama), set env variables ($env:OLLAMA_HOST='0.0.0.0:11434', etc.), and re-run ollama serve.

clean_code_patterns.rule: Avoid mixing DOM rendering with URL encoding or JSON parsing.
clean_code_patterns.implementation: frontend/lib/mediaTrackHelpers.ts exports isGpuAcceleratedStage, getPreviewStreamUrl, getPrimaryTargetLanguage, getLanguageMetadata, and buildRunAudioTracks.
clean_code_patterns.benefit: Eliminated 7 duplicate preview stream URL templates and reduced dynamicTracks useMemo by 70 lines.

clean_code_patterns.rule: Never hardcode language codes or voice mappings in agent business logic.
clean_code_patterns.implementation: backend/app/core/languages.py serves as single source of truth for ISO codes, Kokoro lang_code, Kokoro style personas, and Edge-TTS fallbacks.
clean_code_patterns.benefit: Eliminates duplicate language dictionaries across voice_director.py, tts.py, and test suites.

clean_code_patterns.rule: Always defensively clamp segment timestamps and audio durations before ratio calculations.
clean_code_patterns.implementation: Use max(0.1, duration) across SyncEngineer, DurationAlignStage, and AcousticMasteringEngine.
clean_code_patterns.benefit: Prevents catastrophic pipeline halts from ZeroDivisionError on edge-case audio inputs.

clean_code_patterns.rule: Use atomic temporary file substitution to bypass Windows file locks.
clean_code_patterns.implementation: Write to sibling .tmp.* file first and atomically replace with os.replace().
clean_code_patterns.benefit: Immunity to WinError 32 permission errors during live playback and targeted retries.

operational_runbooks.title: Start / Spin Up LOCALIZE FastAPI Backend
operational_runbooks.description: Spins up FastAPI backend with live reload on port 8000. Swagger docs available at http://localhost:8000/docs.

operational_runbooks.title: Start / Spin Up Next.js Frontend Studio
operational_runbooks.description: Launches Next.js studio console on port 3000 (http://localhost:3000).

operational_runbooks.title: Execute Test Suites
operational_runbooks.description: Runs backend Pytest suite (100+ tests) and frontend Vitest suite (117 tests).

operational_runbooks.title: Start / Spin Up Ollama LLM Server for Client Connections
operational_runbooks.description: Starts Ollama daemon on port 11434. Setting OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 allows LAN/external client connections. Setting OLLAMA_ORIGINS=* enables browser CORS. OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=0 releases VRAM immediately after generation to prevent CUDA OOM during Whisper/Kokoro stages.
